description: This file defines the 'Pocket' entity class related to user pockets in the application. It extends an abstract persistable class, maps to the 'm_pocket' database table, and enforces a unique constraint on 'app_user_id'.

classes.name: Pocket
classes.description: Entity class representing a user pocket, with a reference to the application user ID, mapped to a database table with a unique constraint.

methods.name: getAppUserId
methods.description: Returns the application user's ID associated with this pocket.

methods.name: setAppUserId
methods.description: Sets the application user's ID for this pocket.

methods.name: Pocket
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the pocket with the given application user ID.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Pocket instance with a specific application user ID.
